thread:
emily: Ok team — quick sync. We need a sharp, battle-ready set of claims for next week's launch post + webinar. Goal: a one-pager battlecard and 3 rapid SDR hooks. 
raj: +1. Which opponents are we prioritizing? cloud AI platforms, LLM APIs, infra vendors?
emily: All three. But different angles: cloud platforms = 'managed but variable cost/latency', LLM APIs = 'easy but limited control', infra vendors = 'you run it, you own ops headache'.
taylor: For SDRs we should lead with measurable wins: e.g., "40% lower per-token cost at p95 latency target" or "consistent sub-100ms tail on common prompts" — anything real we can cite?
marco: We have the benchmark draft showing 35–45% cost improvement on conversation workloads with batching + cache vs baseline managed endpoints. p50 latency similar, p95 significantly better because of routing and prefix cache. I can export numbers.
emily: Perfect. Can you boil that into a single 2-line stat per competitor? 
marco: Yep. I'll do: 1) Cloud APIs — cost variability, higher p95 under burst; 2) LLM APIs — opaque routing, limited rollout controls; 3) Infra vendors — heavy ops + no unified dev ergonomics.
jen: For the webinar, propose a 20-min demo (routing + fallback), 15-min benchmark walkthrough, 10-min customer Q&A. We can have a short live play showing a canary rollback.
taylor: SDR hook examples: 
- "Ship generative features without rewriting infra — same API, lower cost." 
- "Avoid surprise tail latency during high concurrency." 
- "SLA-backed dedicated pools for predictable throughput."
Use bite-sized rebuttals too.
emily: Love it. We need 3 one-liners per opponent and 1-line suggested rebuttals for reps. Keep language simple and non-technical for SDRs, include a technical appendix for SEs.
raj: Also add quick objection handlers for procurement: licensing vs commit; include a simple TCO calculator link.
emily: I'll draft the battlecard and post to the doc: https://redwood.internal/marketing/competitive-launch-draft (working link — placeholder). People: tag me with edits by EOD tomorrow.
marco: Uploading benchmark CSV + short notebook in that doc.
taylor: I'll mock the SDR email snippets and a two-slide field summary.
jen: Ops checklist for Private deployments + KMS notes added. Also adding rollback play for webinar demo.
emily: Final ask — pick one standout claim for the launch post headline. My vote: "Same API. Predictable economics. Production SLAs." Thoughts?
raj: Short and sharp. +1.
taylor: +1 from sales. Works.
marco: +1, matches data.
emily: Great — I'll push draft. Thanks all. :rocket:
deploy-bot: Reminder — marketing deploy scheduled for 4951290000 — make sure final docs linked in the CMS before then.
